notes.title: Super-Patriota Simulator Launch
notes.content:
Attention, Patriots! The big day has finally arrived!!111!

[h3]Super-Patriot Simulator is leaving early access[/h3]

The saga finally comes to an end, with new missions and NPCs!

[list]
[*]Flooding in camps
[*]Call Aliens
[*]Destroy HAARP antennas
[*]Find Bananinha’s flash drives
[*]Boss fight against Xanzão!
[*]New achievements
[*]New NPCs such as Cauro Mid, Bananinha, Mergio Soro and Mike da Swat
[*]Credits screen with the names of people who contributed during early access (if your name isn't there, let me know and I'll add it)
[/list]

Unfortunately I had to significantly reduce the game's content, including the events of January 8th and support for video game controllers, if you want to know more, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2089140/view /6738003788159900239]I explain a little in this post[/url].

I will continue to provide general support for the game, with bug updates, but no content updates are planned (the possibility of the game continuing will depend greatly on sales ːsteamhappyː )

Taking the opportunity to reveal the studio's next release, Simulacro, which should be released in August 2024. A first-person puzzle-solving game with a focus on a philosophical narrative, addressing concepts from ancient Greek philosophy.

notes.title: Schedule changes
notes.content:
Hail Zebrileiros!

I would like to share with you some changes to the update schedule.

I don't know if everyone knows, but I'm a solo developer and Super-Patriota Simulator is made in my free time. The game has been in development since November 2022, it took approximately 7 months until the launch of Early Access, in May 2023. Since then, several updates have been released, with corrections and adjustments, including a major content update, with new missions and NPCs .

Due to recent events and changes in routine, I will no longer have as much time available to work on Super-Patriota Simulator, so, unfortunately, I will not be able to launch the update scheduled for September, nor even maintain the pace of releases, nor maintain the amount of originally planned content (missions, NPCs, mechanics, etc.).

Trying to maintain a schedule that is compatible with the amount of hours I can work on the project, I am planning to release the next (and last) update on January 8, 2024. Yes, on January 8th I will release a last content update and remove the game from early access.

This will be the official launch of the game and will be accompanied by a price adjustment, so if you haven't purchased the game yet, take advantage!

The update will have the following contents:

- Call Aliens
- Destroy HARP antennas
- Call Mike Swat to recover lost jewelry and flash drives
- Flooding in barracks
- Explode bombs at the airport
- BOSS fight against Xanzão
[i]- Invasion of Zebrília (if there is no time, it will be released later as DLC)[/i]
- Joystic support
- fixes and adjustments
- New NPCs such as Mergio Soro, Tantan Gallanhol, Cauro Mid and others.
- credits screen with names of everyone who helped during early access

As a solo dev trying to make a living from games, I can't keep a project running for more than 12 months, but I believe this latest update will satisfy the community's main requests.

I will continue to support and fix bugs after launch, but we will no longer have new content.

Thank you for understanding, Patriots!
ZEBRIL ABOVE ALL, GOD ABOVE EVERYONE 1!111!!

If you run into any issues, be sure to let me know on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2089140/discussions/]game forum.[/url]

notes.title: Update 0.2 out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Hail Heroes of the Nation![/h1]

[b]Version 0.2 of Super Patriot Simulator[/b] is available for download! Throughout the month of July I will make available small patches with possible corrections, performance improvements and general optimizations.

Here is the list of news, fixes and tweaks:

[h2][b]News[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]New Upgrade for camps, the Dining Hall, which adds an extra multiplier and can be upgraded up to x5.5!
[*]New quest: steal energy! Help Master Chef Hendrick Pastello to power up the main camp's mess hall.
[*]New Upgrade for the main camp, the Infirmary! Discover the true story of the Titanic and seek to reveal the mystery that lies at the bottom of the sea.
[*]Hack the voting machine and reveal the election FRAUD!
[*]New item, COVID vaccine, which turns the player into an alligator for 30 seconds, increasing the item's Score by x100 times. Syringes are hidden throughout the scenery.
[*]New housing upgrades in the camps, with new quests and new NPC's. Help Barcos Milicianos find the "cult" members and celebrate Xanzão's arrest with Vagno Malte.
[*]New NPC, Karma Isabelli. With just 1 million you can help the crowdfunding and win a pistol to shoot people you don't like.
[*]New menu for choosing screen resolution, in the initial menu.
[*]Options for adjusting mouse sensitivity in the Pause menu.
[*]Achievement Salles for destroying many trees.
[*]20 new achievements, related to new content!
[/list]

[h2][b]Corrections[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Military were amassing inside the barracks.
[*]Airport tower was collision-free.
[*]Quest billboards were buggy when restarting the map.
[*]Typing on the barracks door now has a blinking cursor.
[*]NPC's animation transitions are now smooth.
[/list]

[h2][b]Adjustments and balancing[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Typing bonuses, from duty at the barracks door, are now higher.
[*]Speech on top of truck now provides 0.1 multiplier when finishing a speech, making it possible to combo speeches.
[*]Score required to purchase various improvements and upgrades has been reduced.
[*]Score rewards for some missions have been increased.
[/list]

Any BUG or suggestion,[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2089140/discussions/] visit the forum[/url] and help me by giving your opinion!

On next update I will also bring a list with the news of the next big update that should come out in September.

Thank you all for your support and, if possible, tell your friends about the game and help spread the word!
Bye

notes.title: Update v0.126
notes.content:
Greetings Patriots!

New version available with bug fixes, balance and new content!

[b]Fix: [/b]entering the HQ sometimes crashed the game completely.
[b]Fix:[/b] bench had no collision sound effect.
[b]Fix:[/b] minor improvements and performance tweaks, the game should be a bit lighter now.
[b]Tweak: [/b]decreased initial score time (3s to 2s)
[b]Tweak:[/b] Decreased the additional time coming from bathroom upgrades, now all upgrades only increase the time by 1s.
[b]Adjustment:[/b] It is no longer possible to keep kicking [b]in front[/b] of red cars.
[b]Tweak:[/b] Loading screen now has detailed description of controls (move, jump, run and attack)
[b]Adjustment:[/b] Duty at the barracks door now has a note, better explaining the mechanics.
[b]Tweak:[/b] Decreased the time to show the start menu.
[b]Add:[/b] message from dev in pause menu.
[b]Add: [/b]character will pretend to be run over if he gets in front of a car.
[b]Add:[/b] new achievement for the first time you fake a hit-and-run.

After these balance tweaks, the game should feel a bit more balanced at the start. There's still a lot of content to come and nobody should have much more than 1 million at this point, hahaha.

Remembering that, as soon as the game is balanced, I will reset the scores.

I would also like to inform you that I am already developing new mechanics for the first major update of the game, which will be released by the end of June. Here's the list of what's to come:

- New upgrades for the camps: mess hall, infirmary and games room.
- New missions, including: Titanic Conspiracy, Camp 18+ and Xanzão Prison Celebration Party.
- New item: covid vaccine, which transforms into an alligator for a short period, with score bonus.
- New weapon: Carma Isabeli's pistol. The game will turn into an FPS as if it were CS played with the arrows (instead of WASD)
- New Steam achievements related to new content.

[b]Fix:[/b] Primeiro caminhão estava desaparecendo ao chegar nos cones.
[b]Fix:[/b] começar um novo jogo não estava resetando todas as variáveis do jogo anterior.
[b]Fix:[/b] menu de pause não funcionava se estivesse no trio elétrico ou na porta do quartel.
[b]Ajuste:[/b] valores de pontuação do discurso do trio elétrico foram atualizados, agora está dando menos pontos.
[b]Ajuste:[/b] pequenas mudanças no cenário.
[b]Ajuste:[/b] diminuída a frequência de surgimento dos caminhões.

Agora sim, acho que, por hoje, acabaram os patchs. 
Até amanhã!

SELVA!
